name: dapp_play_extension
summary: Additive surface bolted onto the existing dapp_server: hosts the Godot Instant Games HTML5 build in an iframe, ships a Play in Facebook launcher, exposes /dapp/api/fb_event for the FBInstant SDK shell to relay player events, and exposes /dapp/api/social_graph for the planet_map_scene friends-fetcher. The bridge JS lives at /dapp/play/sdk-bridge.js and is loaded by the iframe-host page. All write events crystal-anchor at tier='fb_event'. The parent dapp_server.active.json card is NOT modified — this sidecar documents only the additions.
engine_pattern: Reuses dapp_server's stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer + string.Template render path. Renders three new templates (play.html, play_embed.html, play_no_build.html) via the same _render_page/_render_inner helpers. The SDK bridge JS is an inline string constant served as application/javascript with no caching. Window-message bridge in play_embed.html relays {type:'mspc_fb_event', ...} messages from the iframe to /dapp/api/fb_event. Optional integration modules (fb_instant_games.FBInstantGamesConnector, social_graph_persistence) are imported lazily and degrade to seed data if missing — the surface never breaks the rest of the dApp.

added_routes.GET /dapp/play: render play.html — lobby with Play in Facebook + Play in browser launchers + live friend count
added_routes.GET /dapp/play/embed: full-page iframe of the Godot HTML5 build (or play_no_build.html fallback if export missing)
added_routes.GET /dapp/play/sdk-bridge.js: serves application/javascript exposing window.MspcDappBridge (sendEvent, fetchSocialGraph, setToken, loadToken)
added_routes.GET /dapp/api/social_graph?player_id=X: BEARER · returns {players, friendships} for planet_map_scene; reads social_graph_persistence if importable, otherwise deterministic seed
added_routes.POST /dapp/api/fb_event: BEARER · body {event_name, player_id, context_id, signed_data, payload}; routes through FBInstantGamesConnector.record_event; crystal-anchors at tier='fb_event', model='dapp_fb_bridge', scope='dapp_<event_name>'

added_templates.studio/dapp/templates/play.html: lobby — Play in Facebook + Play in browser buttons, live HTMX-loaded friend count, SDK-bridge intro panel
added_templates.studio/dapp/templates/play_embed.html: full-page iframe of /studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games/index.html plus the SDK bridge script tag and a window-message relay
added_templates.studio/dapp/templates/play_no_build.html: graceful fallback shown when the Godot HTML5 export hasn't been produced yet (no studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games/index.html present)

added_helpers: _seed_social_graph(player_id) — deterministic seed for the planet_map_scene fetcher
_load_social_graph(player_id) — try social_graph_persistence, fall back to seed
_record_fb_event(event_name, player_id, context_id, signed_data, payload) — try FBInstantGamesConnector.record_event, fall back to no-op
nav_changes: Added one play entry to nav.tabs in studio/dapp/templates/base.html — single-line addition, no other base.html edits

env_vars.FB_INSTANT_APP_ID: FB app id used to build the https://www.facebook.com/instantgames/play/<id> launcher URL; empty → launcher falls back to /dapp/play/embed

constants.GODOT_BUILD_DIR: studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games (expected drop location for the Godot HTML5 export)
constants.GODOT_BUILD_EMBED_SRC: /studio/godot/builds/web_instant_games/index.html (iframe src — served by the studio_runtime or a future static handler)

substrate: additive — no own DB. Reuses freetier_gate.require_token for all write/read auth, inference_logger for crystal anchors, and lazy-imports fb_instant_games.FBInstantGamesConnector + social_graph_persistence when present.

inbound_callers: facebook.com/instantgames embed shell: the bridge JS calls /dapp/api/fb_event + /dapp/api/social_graph
planet_map_scene Godot scene: fetches /dapp/api/social_graph?player_id=X for friend planet rendering
outbound_calls: fb_instant_games.FBInstantGamesConnector.record_event(event_name, player_id, context_id, signed_data, payload) — lazy import, optional
social_graph_persistence.load_graph(player_id) / get_graph / load — lazy import, optional, seed fallback
core/lib/freetier_gate.require_token(headers) on every added write endpoint and the social_graph reader
routing_connections.substrate_writes: crystal chain entries via inference_logger only

graceful_degradations: FB_INSTANT_APP_ID not set → Play in Facebook button routes to /dapp/play/embed
fb_instant_games module missing → fb_event returns 502 {ok:false, backend:'exception'} with the crystal still anchored at rc=1
social_graph_persistence module missing → /dapp/api/social_graph returns deterministic seed data, source='seed'
Godot HTML5 build not exported → /dapp/play/embed renders play_no_build.html with the cc godot-export command
guarantees: Existing dapp_server routes (services, mint, wallet, products, balance, buy, mint, healthz) are NOT modified
dapp_server.active.json is NOT modified — additions live in this sidecar card only
/dapp/api/fb_event and /dapp/api/social_graph are bearer-gated via the same freetier_gate.require_token path the other write endpoints use
Every /dapp/api/fb_event call crystal-anchors at tier='fb_event' even on backend failure
Stdlib-only — no new deps; SDK bridge JS is an inline string constant
Lazy imports of optional modules — server boots even when fb_instant_games / social_graph_persistence don't exist

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.play_lobby: ok — /dapp/play renders with Play in Facebook + Play in browser launchers

phase: Instant Games launch surface. Pairs with the Godot project (studio/godot/project/scenes/planet_map_scene) + future FBInstantGamesConnector + social_graph_persistence modules. Next: cc godot-export web_instant_games target + FB app-id provisioning.
